mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong underlying demand, which increases corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening supply-side capacity, which signals economic contraction and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below its 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal generates positive returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and HOUST fails to generate positive 20-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 9.5% signals labor market distress, which reduces consumer spending and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the interaction signal fails to outperform baseline in 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum, combined with stagnant inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% YoY), indicates a tightening cycle in a low-inflation environment, which increases real rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates strong economic momentum, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction term fails to generate a Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
